lines.en: My body arches and stretches.
I take a bite from the leaf edge.
I creep to the other end of the leaf.
I nearly cross the leaf's rim.
I pull back quickly.
Off the leaf, I would die.
I cling to the leaf, almost transparent.

lines.zh: 我的小脚一下一下抓着。
lines.en: My little feet grip, one after another.
I crawl around a little pile of droppings.
I crawl toward the middle of the leaf.

lines.zh: 我在两片叶之间换了个位置。
lines.en: I move to another leaf.
There is me on a plains leaf.
I stop and raise my head to sniff.
I lower my head and chew again.
I stop at the leaf's heart and hold still.
I curl into a half circle.
I lift my head, then lower it.
I chew with enthusiasm.
I am looking for the next bite.
The sun warms my back.
I dare not go far.
The leaf is everything to me.
I wriggle slowly.

lines.zh: 雪地上没有叶子，我不能去。
lines.en: No leaves on the snow; I cannot go there.
I rest against the vein.

lines.zh: 我把自己藏进叶子的褶皱。
lines.en: I hide in the leaf's fold.
You may pick me up.
Do not squeeze.
The leaf in your hand is good.
Would you put me back?
I lift my head; you are hard to make out.
Do not set me on the ground.
I would starve.

lines.zh: 别把我从叶子上挪走，好吗？
lines.en: Please don't move me off this leaf.
I curl up.
Half a leaf drops away.
My feet can't hold the leaf vein.
I cling to the leaf stem.
My body arches.
I am too frightened to move.
I'm squeezed into a tight curl.
I crawl slowly away.
A leaf! I want the leaf.
Can I eat this?
I sniff; it is a leaf.

lines.zh: 我啃出一个缺口，正好够我躲。
lines.en: I gnaw a notch just big enough to hide in.
That is good.
May I have one more leaf?
I want nothing else.
Do you have another leaf?
I crawl onto your finger.
Do not shake, or I will fall.
I bump into the leaf vein.
You touch me and I curl up.
Your touch makes me grip the leaf edge.
My feet grip the leaf.
The leaf dips under me.

lines.zh: 我在你手指上绕了一圈。
lines.en: I loop around your finger.
I rear up to look.
I press myself back to the leaf.
Do not touch me again.
That comes later.
My task now is eating.
Wait until I grow wings.
I stay on the underside of the leaf.

lines.zh: 同类的味道我没有闻到。
lines.en: I have not smelled any kin.
The leaf matters more.
Two more bites.
The wind blows and I grip.
I keep eating.
You have picked me up.
Your palm is warm.

lines.zh: 把我放到另一片叶子上。
lines.en: Set me on another leaf.
Not on the ground; I would starve.
I grip your finger.

lines.zh: 这是我第一次离叶子这么远。
lines.en: This is my first time this far from a leaf.
I am a little scared.
Is there a leaf up there?
I see one, over there.
Put me there.
There is little I can do.
I only eat leaves.
I only know how to chew leaves, not hide.
I am too small.
There is nowhere to hide.
Do not knock me off the leaf.
I have not become a moth yet.
I am afraid.
Please.
I crawl toward the leaf's center.
I try not to move.
My feet are trembling.
The leaf's edge is too close.
I grip the vein.
I cannot see you anymore.
I curl myself up.
I freeze on the leaf vein.
I want to be back on the leaf.
The blow rolls me over.
I curl into a ring.
I drop a short way.
I catch the leaf.
I cannot say it hurts.
My body goes limp.

lines.zh: 我这身透明翅，还只是幼虫。
lines.en: These clear wings are still larval.
I am holding on.
I cannot hold much longer.

lines.zh: 我从卵里出来，第一次咬叶子。
lines.en: I hatched from an egg and took my first bite of leaf.
I am on a plains leaf.

lines.zh: 雪地边上也能活，只要有叶。
lines.en: I can live by the snow too, as long as there are leaves.
I am only a small worm.
I crawl slowly to the leaf's heart.
My first bite was at the leaf's edge.
It is bright on the leaf.
I knew how to eat from birth.
I hide under the leaf.
I will eat until I grow up.

lines.zh: 叶子烧起来，我赶紧往前爬。
lines.en: The leaf catches fire and I crawl away fast.

lines.zh: 我掉到地上，找不到叶子。
lines.en: I land on the ground and find no leaf.
I soak in the water and my body sinks.
The blast blows me off the leaf.
An arrow grazes my body.
Light strikes and I curl into a ball.
I have been off a leaf too long.

lines.zh: 雷声太响，我把头埋起来。
lines.en: The thunder is too loud and I bury my head.

lines.zh: 没有叶子，我什么也抓不住。
lines.en: No leaf; there is nothing to grip.
